recap.title: Late leveller seals 2-2 thriller between Harlow Cross and Marsh Dock United
recap.summary: A rollercoaster finish left it 2-2 as Harlow Cross dug out a stoppage-time equaliser. At 41' Hartsell was sent off, leaving Marsh Dock United with 10 and pushing Harlow Cross' win probability from 36% to 49%. At 45+2' Rookwood struck from a quick free kick to make it 0-1 and flip Marsh Dock United's chance to 52% (from 14%). And at 90+1' Whitlock punished a corner to make it 2-2, turning Harlow Cross' win probability from 0% to 8% and sending draw probability to 89% after just 2 s. Bellweather was the standout, finishing the game with the top rating of 9.2 — they had a 0.76 chance off target at 15' (from 11.0 m) but later laid on the 66' finish that got Harlow Cross back into it. What the numbers say: final score 2-2, Harlow Cross xG 2.43 to Marsh Dock United 0.73, shots 16 to 9 and possession 63% to 37%. Rookwood (8.5) and Okonkwo-Reid (8.4) also starred in a game that swung wildly before the late leveller.
